fields.name: marketplace
fields.description: Amazon site code, default US. Options: US, UK, DE, FR, JP, CA, IT, ES, MX, AU, TR, IN

fields.name: keyword
fields.description: Search keyword. Translate to the corresponding country's language whenever possible, e.g. use English keywords for the US, German keywords for Germany, etc.

fields.name: asinList
fields.description: ASINs, multiple ASINs comma-separated, max 40. Format: ^[A-Z0-9]+(,[A-Z0-9]+){0,39}$

fields.name: nodeLabel
fields.description: Amazon category name, supports multi-level category names, levels separated by colon :, e.g. Electronics:Headphones

fields.name: matchType
fields.description: Match type. 1 = phrase match (default), 2 = fuzzy match, 3 = exact match

fields.name: showVariation
fields.description: Whether to query variants. Y = yes, N = no (default)

fields.name: dataSnapshotMonth
fields.description: Amazon product data snapshot month. Default nearly (queries last 30 days real-time data). Use yyyyMM format to query historical snapshots (e.g. 202412 for December 2024). Only supports existing historical snapshots, future dates are not supported. Recommended for seasonal analysis to query the same period last year's snapshot for comparison
